label: before
limits: Fresh disposable Chromium profile with native RAF and software WebGL. Renderer is not capped; Date.now/performance.now and simulation clock are not advanced or rewritten.

44 traffic models and138 NPCs remain. Initial player/camera and two actual actor poses at scheduled accident sites are explicit fixture preparation. Responders/couriers are never teleported or marked complete.

Scheduled incidents use the native constructor; natural accidents remain enabled. Physical arrivals require measured responder distance before contingency. Central backup and forced clear are recorded separately and cannot pass physical acceptance.

Paid parcels, confirmation, receipt and return execute native UI/functions. Native QA joystick intent steers the player only to reach the parcel; periodic pointer probes measure native input-to-movement delay.

CDP collection pauses at0/5/10/15min are excluded from frame windows and recorded. Heap/scene counts are finite software-browser observations, not device memory limits or sustained phone FPS certification.

Before serves manifest runtime assets from the pinned Git commit. Camera sweeps, input probes, scheduled purchases and incident sites follow the same wall-clock agenda; actual native simulation and traffic time are reported separately.
